name: What should I look for in a contractor for a second-story addition?
description: Look for experienced, licensed, insured contractors with good references for second-story additions. Balance cost with reputation and quality of work.

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a contractor for a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for a second-story addition, look for extensive experience with similar projects, valid licenses, comprehensive insurance, and strong local references. A practical tradeoff to consider is balancing cost with the contractor's reputation and quality of work; the lowest bid isn't always the best value for such a significant structural project. Ensure they provide clear communication and detailed contracts.
